# LangBuddy.ai

> AI-powered language learning platform offering conversational practice with AI language buddies across 100+ languages and dialects worldwide.

LangBuddy.ai provides personalized AI tutors for language conversation practice, supporting major world languages as well as regional and indigenous languages. The platform is available in multiple interface languages including English, Spanish (es), and French (fr) to serve a global user base.

## Key Topics

- AI language buddies
- Conversation practice
- Language learning
- AI tutors
- Native speaker practice
- Chatbot learning
- AI conversation practice
- Language tutoring
- Multilingual support
- Regional languages
- Indigenous languages
- Personalized learning
- LangBuddy AI platform
